parts.title: Three homes
parts.instructions: Read about the homes. Choose the right home for each question.
parts.passage:
A. Ana’s home
I live on the fourth floor. There are two bedrooms. There isn’t a garden, but we have a big balcony. I can see the city from it.

B. Ben’s home
Our house has a garden. We eat lunch outside when it is sunny. The kitchen is small, and there are three bedrooms.

C. Camila’s home
I live in a small apartment near the park. There is one bedroom. I walk to school in five minutes. My favorite room is the kitchen.

questions.prompt: Who can walk to school in five minutes?
questions.explanation: Camila says she walks to school in five minutes.

questions.prompt: Who has three bedrooms at home?
questions.explanation: Ben’s house has three bedrooms.

questions.prompt: Who can see the city from a balcony?
questions.explanation: Ana sees the city from her balcony.

questions.prompt: Who eats in the garden on sunny days?
questions.explanation: Ben’s family eats outside when it is sunny.

parts.title: A birthday message
parts.instructions: Choose one word for each numbered gap.
parts.passage:
Hi Sofia,
My birthday is (1) ____ Sunday. You can get here (2) ____ bus. Look for the bus stop in front (3) ____ the supermarket. My house is next to it. There (4) ____ a big blue door. See you at two!
Daniel

questions.explanation: Use on with a day of the week.
Use by before a means of transport, such as by bus.
The preposition phrase is in front of.
Use there is for one door.

parts.title: Four short conversations
parts.instructions: Read the questions. Listen twice and choose one answer for each question.
parts.transcript:
Narrator: Question one.
Maya: Is your birthday party on Friday, Leo?
Ben: I wanted Friday, but my sister works then. It's on Saturday.
Maya: Great, see you on Saturday!

Narrator: Question two.
Maya: Can I try on this black jacket?
Ben: Sorry, we only have it in blue in your size.
Maya: That's fine. I'll try the blue one.

Narrator: Question three.
Ben: Where are my keys? Are they on the kitchen table?
Maya: No, they're by the door, on the little chair.
Ben: Oh, I see them now.

Narrator: Question four.
Maya: Can you play the guitar at the school show?
Ben: I can't play the guitar, but I can sing.
Maya: Good. We need a singer.

questions.explanation: Friday was Leo’s first idea. The party is on Saturday.

questions.prompt: Which jacket does the customer try on?
questions.explanation: The shop has the blue jacket in her size.
They’re on the little chair by the door.

questions.prompt: What can the boy do at the show?
questions.explanation: He says that he can sing.

parts.title: A visit to the park
parts.instructions: Listen twice. Write one word or a number in each gap.
parts.transcript: Maya: Hi, this is Mia. Here are the plans for our visit to the park on Sunday. Meet me at the bus stop at ten. We can take bus six. Please bring some water because it is hot today and it looks like tomorrow will be hot too. We can buy lunch at the park. There is a small café next to the gate. See you at ten!

questions.explanation: Mia says the visit is on Sunday.
Mia says to meet at ten.
They are taking bus six.
Mia asks everyone to bring water.
